name: OKC_PURGE_HEADERS
description: Batch headers for the contract purges.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the cpurge batch record.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: User defined Name for the Batch

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: DESCRIPTION

columns.name: STS_CODE
columns.description:
User status of the purge batch for e.g., Open, Submitted, Running, Terminated, Processed, etc
Based on ORA_OKC_PURGE_STATUS lookup

columns.name: PURGE_OPTION_CODE
columns.description:
purge options (based on ORA_OKC_PURGE_OPTION lookup):
HISTORY - Only history versions
ALL - Delete entire contract

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY
columns.description: indicates the user who submitted the batch.

columns.name: SUBMITION_DATE
columns.description: indicates the date and time of the purge batch submition

columns.name: STARTED_DATE
columns.description: indicates the date and time of the purge batch processing started

columns.name: COMPLETED_DATE
columns.description: indicates the date and time of the purge batch processing completed

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the concurrent program.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the Application name spawning the Concurrent Request.

columns.name: CNT_TOTAL
columns.description: Total Count of Contracts in the purge list

columns.name: CNT_DONE
columns.description: Count of Contracts which were processed OK

columns.name: CNT_ERR
columns.description: Count of Contracts which have errors
